newsitem.title: USA: C-COR sees Q4 $0.43/shr after-tax charge. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: C-COR sees Q4 $0.43/shr after-tax charge. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: C-COR Electronics Inc said it anticipates an after-tax charge of about $4.0 million or $0.43 a share for the fourth quarter, stemming from its decision to discontinue its Fremont, Calif., digital fiber optic business.

The company said it experienced a loss, net of tax, from the business of $2.184 million or $0.22 a share through first three quarters of its fiscal 1997. The net of tax loss for all of fiscal 1996 (corrects the period) for the business was $3.095 million or $0.31 a share, it said.

The company said it expects "additional significant losses" from the discontinued business in the fourth quarter. It said it expects to announce its fiscal year fourth quarter and year end financial results on August 20.

It said the phase-down process for the discontinued business will include disposal of inventory, workforce reductions and payment of lease obligations on the facility, to be done over the next nine months.
It said the schedule is designed to enable the company to provide product support and customer service for its facility in State College, Pa.
